scope: Observed fixture audit before correcting the coupled ridge-limit tests; no physical inference claim

weak_case.interpretation: Roundoff can escape the symmetric source-only stationary point to a lower coupled objective. Honest nonsmooth nonconvergence is not a precision test failure.

controlled_limit_case.interpretation: A strong explicit fixed amplitude prior supplies the controlled source-only ridge limit used by both corrected tests. Production defaults and convergence policies were unchanged.

variability: GPU reduction ordering can change the weak-case counts; these are observed counts, not guaranteed outcomes.
